tasks.short: Set scanner colour, size and exposure parameters

steps.what: Inspect the original and select exact scanner settings for the job
Set scanners to selected color densities, sizes, screen rulings and exposure adjustments
Check test scans and adjust settings where the original requires different treatment

tasks.design: Use saved profiles in the {OTHER} scanner control software to load technician-selected parameters. The technician still inspects the original, chooses the exact configuration and checks test scans before production use.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated parameter entry is mixed with original-specific image judgment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native profiles can reuse a selected configuration without repeated keyboard entry.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising tonal, screening and exposure problems particular to the original.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether the resulting scan preserves the intended image.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated settings entry; image judgment and setup verification remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Understand how scanner choices affect printed output

evidence.claim: Saved scanner profile loading is a model knowledge proposal; the digest's preflight cases do not measure scanner setup savings.

assumptions: Boundary is scanner parameter setup and test checks, excluding loading originals, production scanning and final print approval.

Technician captures job id, scanner id, calibration/profile version, density targets, dimensions/scale, resolution or screen ruling and exposure values in s1. Selecting and recording exact values retains35%; missing values or unsupported profiles require manual entry and testing.
OTHER means scanner control software. Test native saved profiles before code; existing automatic profile loading earns no additional saving.
Approval in s1 binds the completed selected configuration, not a future inferred profile. Loading only applies those exact parameters; s3 retains all test scan checks and corrections.
unknowns: Scanner profile capability and actual repeated entry effort
research_questions: Can native profile loading reproduce all selected values without adding test-scan corrections?

already_counted.description: Original assessment, parameter capture and configuration approval

incremental.description: Maintain profiles and inspect calibration-related exceptions
Maintain software access and profile backups

approvals.approved_version: Exact selected configuration snapshot: scanner, profile version and all parameter values; any edit voids permission to load

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R70 gives30 gross minus7 upkeep=23 net. Existing profile use yields zero; repeated manual settings entry for similar originals may yield5%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less scanner parameter entry while original assessment and test-scan judgment remain human.
reach: Coordinate reproduction requirements with press operators
role.ambitious_version: A prepress technician who reuses exact scanner profiles without hiding original-specific corrections.
